parameters.jsCode:
function pgStr(v) { return v === null || v === undefined ? 'NULL' : `'` + String(v).replace(/'/g, `''`) + `'`; }
function pgNum(v) { return v === null || v === undefined || v === '' || isNaN(Number(v)) ? 'NULL' : Number(v); }
function pgBool(v) { return v === null || v === undefined ? 'NULL' : (v ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE'); }
function pgJsonb(v) { return (v === null || v === undefined) ? "'[]'::jsonb" : `'` + JSON.stringify(v).replace(/'/g, `''`) + `'::jsonb`; }

// Wird nur erreicht, wenn "DB: Naechstes Tage-Paket laden" 0 offene/laufende Schritte mehr
// findet - berechnet die Kennzahlen direkt in SQL (Aggregation ueber simulation_trades +
// simulation_daily_portfolio), idempotent per ON CONFLICT (simulation_run_id).
const runId = $json.run_id;

const sql = `BEGIN;
WITH trades AS (
  SELECT * FROM trading.simulation_trades WHERE simulation_run_id = ${pgNum(runId)} AND status = 'closed'
),
daily AS (
  SELECT simulated_date, total_equity, drawdown_pct,
         total_equity / NULLIF(LAG(total_equity) OVER (ORDER BY simulated_date), 0) - 1 AS daily_return
  FROM trading.simulation_daily_portfolio WHERE simulation_run_id = ${pgNum(runId)}
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT total_equity FROM trading.simulation_daily_portfolio WHERE simulation_run_id = ${pgNum(runId)} ORDER BY simulated_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS final_equity,
    (SELECT initial_capital FROM trading.backtest_runs WHERE id = ${pgNum(runId)}) AS initial_capital,
    (SELECT MAX(drawdown_pct) FROM trading.simulation_daily_portfolio WHERE simulation_run_id = ${pgNum(runId)}) AS max_drawdown_pct,
    (SELECT stddev(daily_return) * sqrt(252) * 100 FROM daily) AS volatility_pct,
    (SELECT CASE WHEN stddev(daily_return) > 0 THEN AVG(daily_return) / stddev(daily_return) * sqrt(252) ELSE NULL END FROM daily) AS sharpe_ratio,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM trades) AS trade_count,
    (SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0) FROM trades) AS wins,
    (SELECT AVG(net_pnl) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0) FROM trades) AS average_win,
    (SELECT AVG(net_pnl) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl <= 0) FROM trades) AS average_loss,
    (SELECT SUM(net_pnl) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0) FROM trades) AS sum_wins,
    (SELECT SUM(ABS(net_pnl)) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl <= 0) FROM trades) AS sum_losses,
    (SELECT AVG(holding_period_days) FROM trades) AS avg_holding,
    (SELECT SUM(commission_total) FROM trades) AS total_commission,
    (SELECT SUM(slippage_total) FROM trades) AS total_slippage,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.simulation_orders WHERE simulation_run_id = ${pgNum(runId)} AND execution_status = 'not_filled_price') AS unfilled,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.simulation_orders WHERE simulation_run_id = ${pgNum(runId)}) AS total_orders,
    (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(strategy, stats) FROM (
      SELECT strategy, jsonb_build_object('trade_count', count(*), 'win_rate_pct', round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0) / GREATEST(count(*), 1), 2), 'total_net_pnl', round(SUM(net_pnl)::numeric, 2)) AS stats
      FROM trades GROUP BY strategy
    ) sub) AS metrics_by_strategy
)
INSERT INTO trading.simulation_metrics
  (simulation_run_id, final_equity, total_return_pct, max_drawdown_pct, volatility_pct, sharpe_ratio,
   win_rate_pct, profit_factor, average_win, average_loss, trade_count, average_holding_period_days,
   total_commission, total_slippage, unfilled_order_pct, metrics_by_strategy_json)
SELECT ${pgNum(runId)}, final_equity,
  CASE WHEN initial_capital > 0 THEN (final_equity - initial_capital) / initial_capital * 100 ELSE NULL END,
  max_drawdown_pct, volatility_pct, sharpe_ratio,
  CASE WHEN trade_count > 0 THEN 100.0 * wins / trade_count ELSE NULL END,
  CASE WHEN sum_losses > 0 THEN sum_wins / sum_losses ELSE NULL END,
  average_win, average_loss, trade_count, avg_holding, total_commission, total_slippage,
  CASE WHEN total_orders > 0 THEN 100.0 * unfilled / total_orders ELSE NULL END,
  COALESCE(metrics_by_strategy, '{}'::jsonb)
FROM agg
ON CONFLICT (simulation_run_id) DO UPDATE SET
  final_equity = EXCLUDED.final_equity, total_return_pct = EXCLUDED.total_return_pct,
  max_drawdown_pct = EXCLUDED.max_drawdown_pct, volatility_pct = EXCLUDED.volatility_pct,
  sharpe_ratio = EXCLUDED.sharpe_ratio, win_rate_pct = EXCLUDED.win_rate_pct, profit_factor = EXCLUDED.profit_factor,
  average_win = EXCLUDED.average_win, average_loss = EXCLUDED.average_loss, trade_count = EXCLUDED.trade_count,
  average_holding_period_days = EXCLUDED.average_holding_period_days, total_commission = EXCLUDED.total_commission,
  total_slippage = EXCLUDED.total_slippage, unfilled_order_pct = EXCLUDED.unfilled_order_pct,
  metrics_by_strategy_json = EXCLUDED.metrics_by_strategy_json, computed_at = now();

UPDATE trading.backtest_runs SET status = 'completed', finished_at = now(), progress_percent = 100 WHERE id = ${pgNum(runId)} AND status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled');
COMMIT;`;

return [{ json: { sql, run_id: runId } }];
